summary: Kapowarr is a self-hosted tool designed to organise and manage digital comic book collections. It handles automated downloading, file renaming, moving, and conversion tasks for specific comic volumes.
goodFor: It suits comic enthusiasts who want to curate and automate their digital reading collections on a personal server.
watchOut: The project exhibits a slowing maintenance rate, which may affect long-term bug fixes and compatibility with external indexers or scrapers.
deployNotes: As a Python application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to map persistent volumes for your downloaded media and library database, along with a reverse proxy if you require external HTTPS access.
